CHIEF GUEST

DTM YOGENDRAPRASAD SATHIYASEELAN

CHARTERED ACCOUNTANT AND CHIEF OPERATING OFFICER OF IWS HOLDINGS (PRIVATE) LIMITED.

We are deeply honored to present DTM Yogendraprasad Sathiyaseelan as our Chief Guest for DESTINY ’26. As a distinguished Chartered Accountant and Chief Operating Officer of IWS Holdings (Private) Limited, he brings a wealth of executive leadership, strategic corporate vision, financial governance, and an inspiring dedication to empowering youth through education.

"Master Mind Education proudly welcomes DTM Yogendraprasad Sathiyaseelan to celebrate five years of transforming potential into excellence."

EVENT GUIDELINES

TERMS & CONDITIONS

Please read these event terms carefully. They are intended to keep DESTINY ’26 safe, welcoming, punctual, and enjoyable for everyone.

  1. ENTRY & TICKETS

    Please bring your valid invitation, ticket, or entry pass and present it to the registration team when requested. Do not share, copy, or transfer a pass without prior approval from the event organisers.

  2. PUNCTUALITY & PROGRAMME

    The hall opens for guests at 12:00 PM. The programme is scheduled to begin at 1:00 PM. Please arrive early, complete registration promptly, and follow announcements from the event team. Timings may be adjusted by the organisers if necessary.

  3. DRESS CODE

    Wear formal or smart-casual attire suitable for an official anniversary celebration. Please follow any additional dress instructions issued by Master Mind Education.

  4. RESPECTFUL CONDUCT

    Treat the Chief Guest, invited guests, teachers, students, organisers, venue staff, and fellow attendees respectfully. Harassment, bullying, disruptive behaviour, or offensive language will not be accepted.

  5. PHONES & SILENCE

    Keep mobile phones on silent during speeches, performances, presentations, and other formal programme segments. Avoid calls or conversations that may disturb the audience.

  6. PHOTOGRAPHY & PRIVACY

    Official photography and video recording may take place for event documentation and promotion. Be respectful when photographing or sharing images of others, and follow any instructions from the media team or organisers.

  7. SEATING & MOVEMENT

    Follow ushers’ directions for seating and guest movement. Keep entrances, exits, aisles, and emergency routes clear. Do not enter restricted backstage, technical, or organiser-only areas without permission.

  8. SAFETY & VENUE CARE

    Follow venue safety instructions and directions from authorised staff. Do not tamper with sound, lighting, electrical, or other event equipment. Report hazards, damage, or emergencies to an organiser immediately.

  9. CLEANLINESS & PROPERTY

    Keep the venue clean, dispose of rubbish responsibly, and handle venue furniture and equipment with care. Attendees may be held responsible for damage caused by deliberate misuse.

  10. FOLLOW ORGANISERS’ INSTRUCTIONS

    Cooperate with registration staff, ushers, security personnel, and the organising committee. Committee members should follow their assigned duties and communicate any issue to their team head promptly.

  11. PROHIBITED CONDUCT

    Dangerous items, unlawful activity, deliberate disruption, and conduct that puts others at risk are not permitted. The organisers may take reasonable steps to protect the safety and comfort of attendees.

  12. RIGHT OF ADMISSION & ORGANISER DECISIONS

    Admission and continued attendance are subject to these terms and applicable venue requirements. The organisers may address breaches, resolve event-day issues, and make reasonable operational changes when needed for safety or smooth running of the programme.

  13. QUESTIONS & ASSISTANCE

    If you need help, have an accessibility concern, or are unsure where to go, please approach the registration desk or an identifiable organising committee member.
